verdict.rationale: The only evidence on this story is a community comment noting Bevy's Asset V2 preprocessing and .meta files. That points to a built-in asset-processing pipeline with per-asset settings (preset-like), but no first-party documentation describes how import hooks, custom processors or batch pipeline scripts work. Hot-reload and glTF loading are about loading assets, not automated import processing, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of asset preprocessing and processors, details of .meta per-asset settings and presets, evidence of custom import hooks or pipeline scripting, hands-on corroboration of batch automation.

support.subject: As a technical artist, asset import is automatable — import hooks, presets, and pipeline scripts process incoming assets without hand-clicking each one

citations.quote: Asset V2 preprocessing and .meta files look super useful.
